name: representation_profile
description: One learned or exact representation the admission compiler may spend an axis budget on, and the envelope actually measured for it. A representation with no measured envelope is not admitted however promising it looks, because a budget that bends is a suggestion: when nothing satisfies the budget the work runs exact and the closest miss is named rather than quietly used. The row states what was measured, never what is hoped -- recall and latency here are facts about a past measurement on a stated axis, and they carry no claim about the next query.
